name: Perfurante - [MMMM]
description:
Daggers and arrows and teeth, oh my! Treat Perfurante wounds gingerly, as they are likely to be painful and make movimento and action more difficult in general. And always be wary of wounds to the abdomen. A perforated bowel left untreated is
a death sentence. As a side note, I find that advising my patients never to run with scissors reduces the rate of Perfurante related complaints by a surprising amount.

results.description:
You've taken grievous Dano directly to your right eye. Your eye is sem funcionamento . Se não for tratado dentro de 8 horas, your vision will be beyond saving (and be considered ausente ).

Tratamento - A DC 20 Teste de Resistência Cirurgia Sensorial.
results.name: Gouged Right Olho

results.description:
Role na @UUID[Compendium.mmm.mmmm-pt-BR.RollTable.iP8lOROAIYARwcgk]{Tabela de Membros Grandes}. Through precision or just sheer luck, the blow has severed a nerve in one of your major limbs. Este membro fica sem funcionamento and não cicatrizará corretamente sem Cirurgia.

Tratamento - A DC 22 Teste de Resistência Cirurgia de Membro.
results.name: Seccionado Nerve

results.description:
Role na @UUID[Compendium.mmm.mmmm-pt-BR.RollTable.vG8gsjqxGB7y9cSD]{Tabela de Apêndices Pequenos}. Você sente a stabbing pain in seu apêndice, and then an instant numbness. O apêndice is sem funcionamento and não cicatrizará corretamente sem Cirurgia.

Tratamento - A DC 20 Teste de Resistência Cirurgia Sensorial.
results.name: Seccionado Small Nerve

results.description:
A ferida superficial fecha facilmente, but o ataque deixou uma contaminação insidiosa profundamente alojada. At the end of every Long Rest, roll your class's hit die and reduce your max Hit Points by this amount. If this effect reduces your Hit Points to 0, you fall &Reference[unconscious]{unconscious} and will die in [[1d6]] dias.

Tratamento - Once per day you may attempt a [[/save con 22]] Saving Throw or a [[/skill medicine 17]] check. A success on either cures the infection. The Greater Restoration spell restores the max hit point Dano as usual, but does not cure the infection.
results.name: Profunda Infecção

results.description: You bite back a snarl as the attack penetrates just a little bit deeper. Você sofre one extra dado de Dano of whatever type the Dano causado.
results.name: Profunda Perforation

results.description:
O ataque sinks into the meat of your arm. It's probably not serious, but the pain makes you treat your arm gingerly. You no longer get one free object interaction per turn. Este efeito dura [[1d8]] turns.

Tratamento - Any amount of magical healing will end this effect.
results.name: Punctured Braço

results.description:
You cough up blood. The wound has made it past your ribs and into your lung. You make Strength (Athletics) and Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks at disadvantage for [[1d6]] dias.

Tratamento - A [[/skill medicine 15]] check reduces the duration of this injury by [[1d4]] dias.
results.name: Punctured Pulmão

results.description:
O ataque went in one end and out the other. Luckily, it's missed anything vital, but you can still feel the agony of it in every motion you make. Bonus actions require a full action instead. Este efeito dura for [[1d4]] dias.

Tratamento - A [[/skill medicine 15]] check reduces the duration of this injury by [[1d2]] dias.
results.name: Ran Through

results.description: Role na @UUID[Compendium.mmm.mmmm-pt-BR.RollTable.5EyNHyXKtfhIlYCa]{Tabela de Cicatrizes}. Você fica com a raised, gnarled scar on this area of seu corpo.
results.name: Retorcida Cicatriz

results.description: Role na @UUID[Compendium.mmm.mmmm-pt-BR.RollTable.5EyNHyXKtfhIlYCa]{Tabela de Cicatrizes}. Você fica com an indented, depressed scar on this area of seu corpo.
results.name: Rebaixada Cicatriz

results.description:
O ataque sinks into the meat of your leg. It's probably not serious, but the pain of it makes you treat your leg gingerly. Your speed is reduced by 10 pés for [[1d8]] rodadas.

Tratamento - Any amount of magical healing will end this effect.
results.name: Punctured Leg

results.description: What did that attack even hit? Your liver? Your spleen? Whatever it was, who knew it could hurt so much? You let out an ear-splitting cry of pain. If the enemy wasn't aware of you, they sure are now. Every creature dentro de 60 pés of you knows your exact location, and you are no longer hidden.
results.name: Visceral Pain

results.description: Role na @UUID[Compendium.mmm.mmmm-pt-BR.RollTable.5EyNHyXKtfhIlYCa]{Tabela de Cicatrizes}. Você fica com a scar that somehow gives you a distinct roguish charm. When this scar is visible you have a +1 bonus to Charisma (Deception) checks. If you collect multiple Roguish Scars, this bonus does not stack.
results.name: Ladina Cicatriz

results.description:
O ataque is over, but it's left something left behind. An arrowhead, a chip from the creature's tooth, or the broken point of a sword, perhaps. Whatever it is, you can still feel it cutting dentro de you. Any time you use an action, Bonus Action, and movimento on the same turn you are &Reference[incapacitated]{incapacitated} until the end of your next turn.

Tratamento - A DC 19 Cirurgia Geral removes the foreign body and ends this effect.
results.name: Foreign Body

results.description:
You look down at your stomach and a wave of cold fear washes over you. You've taken a gut wound, and it's only a matter of time until it turns septic. Você fica &Reference[poisoned]{poisoned}. Every 24 horas you gain 1 level of &Reference[exhaustion]{exhaustion}. This level of exhaustion may not be removed by não mágico means.

Tratamento - A DC 21 Cirurgia Geral. Any effect that cures disease will remove 1 level of exhaustion. A Lesser Restoration spell temporarily removes the poisoned condition for 24 horas. A Greater Restoration spell removes exhaustion levels as usual, but does not stop the infection.
results.name: Perfurado Intestino

Tratamento - A DC 20 Teste de Resistência Cirurgia Sensorial.
results.name: Gouged Left Olho
